title: Evaluation and scalar tensor comparisons for semilinear systems
statement: Given the base tensor models and a SystemScalarCoherence, there are the normalized evaluation isomorphisms and TensorComparisonModels, and the normalized scalar/tensor isomorphisms and ScalarTensorComparisonModels.

source.place: Construction 4.1, sectionwise tensor comparison and derived scalar extension.

proof.text: For each level n apply semilinearTensorEvaluation to A.closed, A.tensorModels, A.levelClosed n and A.levelTensorModels n. Its existential witnesses give the evaluation isomorphism and the dependent TensorComparisonModel, with exactly the ordinaryEvaluationTensor normalization required by the third field.

For each n <= m, apply semilinearScalarTensor to the composite coefficientMap, the given S.scalar h, and the given closed structures and tensor models at m and n. This gives the scalar tensor isomorphism and a nonempty ScalarTensorComparisonModel for those precise choices. No new scalar data or coherence theorem is needed.

Choose the isomorphisms together with their dependent models from these two existing existence theorems. Retain the evaluation normalization by choose_spec. Assemble the five fields of SystemTensorComparisons and introduce Nonempty. All choices are within the proof of a proposition; no definition or new data construction is introduced.
